observations: No lateral design at all (no shear walls, hold-downs, seismic or wind report) although the hand report lists SDPWS 2015 and IBC load combinations and asks for 'seismic/uplift factored' connectors.
Edition mismatch: drawings 2022 CRC; hand report IBC 2018 / CBC 2019 / NDS 2015 / SDPWS 2015; Tedds posts NDS 2018; footing ACI 318-14 with 'Load combinations per IBC 2018'.
Floor framing mismatch: drawings S-1 'TJI 210 @16" O.C.' (and S-2 'TJI 210 @24" O.C.') vs calc 2×10 @16″ sawn joists; roof trusses only given global demand (manufacturer to design).

Roof live load 0 psf used for trusses/rafters (labelled 'Roof live (snow)'); minimum 20 psf roof live load omitted. Lumber values Fb 875 / Fv 135 / E 1.3e6 psi without species/grade or adjustment factors.

Pad footing (4'x4'x15", 6 #5 bottom / 4 #4 top — matches S-3 bar callouts) designed for D = 30.0 kips + L = 35.0 kips per column, far above the 6x6 post loads (P = 16120 / 15180 / 12420 / 11040 lb); ULS check omits seismic combinations.

6X6 POSTS design section 2 is internally inconsistent (DF-South material vs DF-L properties; 6x8 section properties on a 5.5x5.5 post; summary table vs detailed results differ: 0.617 vs 0.718 compression, 0.564 vs 0.717 combined).
Post 1 combined ratio 0.984 under 'Permanent' duration — close to capacity; drawing post grade not stated (calc DF-L No.1).
